description: Figure 5, which is presented on the right side of the figure and corresponds to the threshold of 1e-3 as indicated in its caption, displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values after gating. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and ranges from 0 to 20, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains three distinct lines: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gate with an average value of 0.03; an orange dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after gate with an average value of 0.44; and a green dashed line representing the sparsity ratio after average gate with an average value of 0.33. The blue dashed line remains consistently low, hovering near 0.0 across all layers. The orange dotted line starts near 1.0 at layer 0 and declines sharply to approximately 0.2 by layer 10, then exhibits some fluctuation before stabilizing near 0.2. The green dashed line follows a similar declining trend, starting near 1.0 and decreasing to approximately 0.1 by layer 20.
